method: Independent source review plus execution of current IT handler suite; no browser or real account.

findings.evidence: The isolated HTTP test first returned422 for a maintenance-only reviewer. Root changed validate_targets capability (default remains checklists.approve), maintenance publication and BrowserTemplates reviewer catalog. Final browser-publication test passed, including checklist exclusion and unchanged permissions.

assigneeOptions retains exact selected user_id outside matches, unavailable selection stays explicit; filterAssignees snapshots business fields but stores query separately; payload validates against currently offered IDs. Homonym IDs are escaped; no recovery email or HR phone is used.

capture combines identity, hash, epoch, readSerial and host; loadHistory checks current capture and previous detail object.403/401/404 clear detail/data through readError; temporary errors preserve authorized history. syncSession resets lastViewed/focus and protects retained forms by account.
busy/uncertain blocks search and editing. Retry preserves f.request; beforeSend guard rechecks current form/account/access. No logout or permission changes in new handlers.

Return focuses previous request link or results count; search has a label and aria-describedby status. Existing focus styling and narrow form sizing remain. Native select popup and visual rendering were not tested.

executions.notes: Executed independently against final root source.

backend_invariants: Only two recognized capabilities allowed by validator.
Default checklist contract remains unchanged for existing callers.
Maintenance review still requires current named reviewer and maintenance.approve; assignment does not grant authority.
Current service permission checks precede idempotent replay.
No table, stored record, account policy or permission grant changed.
limitations: No browser/Chrome, production or external service accessed.
No new complete HTTP TI journey; current root handler tests use synthetic data and real prior API fixture.
Visual contrast/layout and actual device keyboard interactions require browser confirmation.
